tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background. Dark: slate. Light: paper.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels and cards on bg (skill card, map card, HUD, leaderboard).

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Anything floating: modal, toast, menus, popovers.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells inside a surface: input fields, histogram and bar tracks, the frame around a board.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and dividers between rows. Decorative only: never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, secondary buttons, chips). At least 3:1 on bg, surface and surface-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons, on bg, surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: metadata, labels, units. 4.5:1 or better on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholders, disabled labels, axis ticks. Still 4.5:1 on surface and surface-raised; do not use for anything a player must read to act.

tokens.name: chalk
tokens.usage: The player's colour: primary button fill, selected tab bar, your row on a leaderboard, your bar in a histogram. Chalk on slate in dark, graphite on paper in light.

tokens.name: on-chalk
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a chalk fill.

tokens.name: chalk-soft
tokens.usage: Hover and selected backgrounds (rows, tabs, chips). Text on it stays ink.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring and the coach's mark in UI. Solid 2px ring with a 2px bg gap; 5:1 or better on every surface.

tokens.name: good
tokens.usage: Cleared, refunded, compatible. Cyan, off the red-green axis, so it never relies on hue against critical. As text on any surface or good-soft. Always paired with the check icon or a word.

tokens.name: good-soft
tokens.usage: Background behind good text (badges, toasts).

tokens.name: on-good
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a solid good fill.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Close to a limit: steps nearly used, low credits, skill needs an unlock this map lacks. As text on any surface or warning-soft. Always with the triangle icon or a word.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Background behind warning text.

tokens.name: on-warning
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a solid warning fill.

tokens.name: critical
tokens.usage: Failed run, agent lost, goal flooded, payment error. As text on any surface or critical-soft. Always with the octagon icon or a word.

tokens.name: critical-soft
tokens.usage: Background behind critical text.

tokens.name: on-critical
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a solid critical fill (destructive button).

tokens.name: crew-a
tokens.usage: PvP crew A (left side; the viewer's own crew when they play). Text on any surface; ring colour on agent avatars. Always paired with the letter A.

tokens.name: crew-b
tokens.usage: PvP crew B (right side). Blue vs orange stays apart for every common colour-vision type. Always paired with the letter B.

tokens.name: tile-floor
tokens.usage: Board floor: open, walkable tile. Same in both themes: the board is always a dark window into the sim.

tokens.name: tile-grid
tokens.usage: Grid hairline between tiles, drawn at 16px tiles and up. Decorative.

tokens.name: tile-wall
tokens.usage: Stone wall (`solid`, `blocks`). Pattern: brick joints in tile-wall-mark.

tokens.name: tile-wall-mark
tokens.usage: Brick joints on a wall tile.

tokens.name: tile-water
tokens.usage: Water (`spreads`, `liquid`). Pattern: two waves in tile-water-mark, drifting sideways.

tokens.name: tile-water-mark
tokens.usage: Wave lines on water. 3.1:1 on tile-water.

tokens.name: tile-lava
tokens.usage: Lava (`spreads`, `liquid`, `damages`). Pattern: glowing crack in tile-lava-mark. Darker than fire so the two never share a lightness.

tokens.name: tile-lava-mark
tokens.usage: Crack lines on lava. 3.5:1 on tile-lava.

tokens.name: tile-fire
tokens.usage: Fire (`spreads`, `damages`). Glyph: dark flame in tile-fire-mark, flickering. The lightest hazard.

tokens.name: tile-fire-mark
tokens.usage: Flame on a fire tile. 5.4:1 on tile-fire.

tokens.name: tile-grass
tokens.usage: Grass (`flammable`). Pattern: three tufts in tile-grass-mark.

tokens.name: tile-grass-mark
tokens.usage: Tufts on grass. 3.4:1 on tile-grass.

tokens.name: tile-crate
tokens.usage: Wooden crate (`solid`, `pushable`, `flammable`). Glyph: frame and X brace in tile-crate-mark. Much lighter than grass so the Ember Warehouse fuel line reads under protanopia.

tokens.name: tile-crate-mark
tokens.usage: Frame and brace on a crate. 4.3:1 on tile-crate.

tokens.name: tile-dirt
tokens.usage: Dirt (`solid`, `blocks`, `breakable`). Pattern: stipple in tile-dirt-mark. Removed by dig.

tokens.name: tile-dirt-mark
tokens.usage: Stipple dots on dirt. 3.5:1 on tile-dirt.

tokens.name: tile-block
tokens.usage: Placed block (`solid`, `blocks`), put down by a Builder. Glyph: inset frame and plus in tile-block-mark. Lighter than wall so a player can see what their agent built.

tokens.name: tile-block-mark
tokens.usage: Frame and plus on a placed block. 4.1:1 on tile-block.

tokens.name: tile-gem
tokens.usage: Gem, key or crystal (`collectible`). Glyph: faceted diamond on floor, outlined in tile-gem-mark.

tokens.name: tile-gem-mark
tokens.usage: Outline and facets of the collectible diamond.

tokens.name: tile-exit
tokens.usage: Exit door or flag (`goal`). Glyph: dark arch in tile-exit-mark.

tokens.name: tile-exit-mark
tokens.usage: Door arch on an exit tile. 6.4:1 on tile-exit.

tokens.name: tile-agent
tokens.usage: Agent body: a chalk circle, the only round thing on a board. 13.9:1 on tile-floor.

tokens.name: tile-agent-mark
tokens.usage: Agent face (the >_ prompt) and outline.

tokens.name: tile-mark
tokens.usage: Critical spot highlight (dam spot, firebreak): pink corner brackets, always over a tile-mark-halo stroke so they read on any tile. Replays, spectator view and map editor only.

tokens.name: tile-mark-halo
tokens.usage: Dark underlay stroke under tile-mark brackets and under the agent outline.

families.sans: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next", "Atkinson Hyperlegible", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif
families.mono: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Pixelify Sans: letters built on a pixel grid, like the boards. 24px and up only.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Final score on the results screen; the wordmark beside the logo mark.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Page titles and map names on the map screen.

styles.name: display-md
styles.usage: Section titles, modal titles, PvP timer.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Atkinson Hyperlegible Next: made for low-vision readers, clear 1/l/I and 0/O.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Card titles: skill names, map names in cards, agent names.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Seal the spillway first, then collect.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, tabs, field labels, column headers.

groups.name: Mono
groups.note: Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono: every number that ticks, and every engine word (tags, actions).

styles.name: hud
styles.usage: Run HUD counters, credits balance. Tabular figures so digits do not jump each tick.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Tag names, action names, coordinates, Elo, prices.

styles.name: mono-sm
styles.usage: Probabilities, axis labels, legend characters. The smallest text in the game.

spacing.note: 4px base. Tiles are not spacing: see tileSize.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label; between chips in a row.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips and small buttons; between stacked label and field.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button side padding; gap between HUD stats.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; the page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Modal padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between cards in a grid; board margin.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Top of page; above a results score.

radius.note: Tiles are square, so the chrome is nearly square. Only agents are round.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Board tiles. Never round a tile.

tokens.name: radius-1
tokens.usage: Chips, badges, histogram bars, the board frame.

tokens.name: radius-2
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, tabs, toasts.

tokens.name: radius-3
tokens.usage: Cards and the modal.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Agents and agent avatars only.

shadow.note: Dark theme leans on a 1px edge more than a shadow; shadows only lift floating things.

tokens.name: elev-1
tokens.usage: Cards at rest (skill card, map card, crew slot).

tokens.name: elev-2
tokens.usage: Toasts, menus, a lifted card on hover.

tokens.name: elev-3
tokens.usage: The modal.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every control: a 2px bg gap, then 2px of focus pink. Box-shadow so it follows the radius.

tileSize.note: Board tile edge in px. Pick the largest that fits; detail drops at each step.

tokens.name: tile-size-xs
tokens.usage: Map thumbnails. Fill colour plus shapes for agent, gem and exit; no patterns.

tokens.name: tile-size-sm
tokens.usage: Smallest live board (PvP split screen on a laptop, phones). Full glyphs, simplified patterns.

tokens.name: tile-size-md
tokens.usage: Default live and replay board.

tokens.name: tile-size-lg
tokens.usage: Large solo run view, map detail.

tokens.name: tile-size-xl
tokens.usage: Legend swatches and tutorials.

duration.note: Board motion must finish inside 40% of a tick; at fast replay speeds use min(token, tick x 0.4).

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, press, chip toggle.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Tabs, toasts in, modal in.

tokens.name: duration-step
tokens.usage: An agent sliding one tile.

tokens.name: duration-spread
tokens.usage: A hazard growing into a new tile.

tokens.name: duration-loop
tokens.usage: Ambient loops: water drift, lava glow, mark pulse.

tokens.name: duration-toast
tokens.usage: How long a non-critical toast stays. Critical toasts stay until dismissed.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: UI enter and move.

tokens.name: ease-step
tokens.usage: Agent steps: quick start, soft stop on the tile.

tokens.name: ease-spread
tokens.usage: Hazard spread: bursts in, settles.
